sentences.en: Today, it was supposed to be a relatively simple part of preparing for the coronavirus in the United States.
sentences.zh: 今天，这本来应该是美国为冠状病毒做准备过程中相对简单的一个环节。

sentences.en: Testing for it.

sentences.en: My colleague Sherry Fink on What Went Wrong.
sentences.zh: 我的同事雪莉·芬克讲述哪里出了问题。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, March 11th.
sentences.zh: 今天是3月11日，星期三。

sentences.en: So in 2018, it was the 100th anniversary of the terrible 1918 flu pandemic.
sentences.zh: 所以在2018年，那是可怕的1918年流感大流行100周年。

sentences.en: This was called the
sentences.zh: 这被称为

sentences.en: Spanish flu, and it just killed millions and millions of people around the world.
sentences.zh: 西班牙流感，它夺去了全球数百万人的生命。

sentences.en: So on that
sentences.zh: 因此在那

sentences.en: 100th year anniversary, many gatherings were held to discuss the lessons of that flu pandemic for today.
sentences.zh: 100周年纪念之际，人们举行了许多集会，讨论那场流感大流行对当今的启示。

sentences.en: And there was this one gathering of high-level people in Atlanta, Georgia, where the Centers for
sentences.zh: 在佐治亚州亚特兰大市有这样一场高层聚会，疾病控制与

sentences.en: Disease Control and Prevention is based.
sentences.zh: 预防中心就设在那里。

sentences.en: And among the officials there was a group from the National
sentences.zh: 在与会的官员中，有一个来自国家

sentences.en: Security Council.
sentences.zh: 安全委员会的小组。

sentences.en: It had actually been created, a special unit on global health security that was created after that terrible Ebola outbreak in West Africa.
sentences.zh: 实际上，这是一个专门的全球卫生安全部门，是在西非那场可怕的埃博拉疫情爆发后创建的。

sentences.en: So let's begin with you, Dr. Gordon.
sentences.zh: 那么让我们从您开始，戈登博士。

sentences.en: So one of the officials with that group, with that unit.
sentences.zh: 所以这是该小组、该部门的一位官员。

sentences.en: Well, it's a pleasure to be here with so many of my colleagues, and we've been working together for more than a decade on these issues.
sentences.zh: 很高兴能与我的这么多同事齐聚一堂，我们十多年来一直在这个问题上并肩合作。

sentences.en: She steps up to the podium, and she says, the threat of pandemic flu is our number one health security concern.
sentences.zh: 她走上讲台说，流感大流行的威胁是我们首要的卫生安全关切。

sentences.en: So this is a pretty senior health official on the National Security Council
sentences.zh: 所以这是国家安全委员会的一位资深卫生官员，

sentences.en: warning her colleagues that there is a very predictable threat here, a pandemic flu.
sentences.zh: 在警告她的同事们，这里存在一个非常可预测的威胁，即流感大流行。

sentences.en: And are we ready to respond to a pandemic?
sentences.zh: 我们准备好应对大流行了吗？

sentences.en: I fear the answer is no.
sentences.zh: 我恐慌答案是否定的。

sentences.en: In her words, the country's just not really ready for it.
sentences.zh: 用她的话说，这个国家根本没有真正做好准备。

sentences.en: So we should do something about it.
sentences.zh: 所以我们应该采取行动。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And as it happens, the very next day, that global health security unit where she worked was shut down by a senior member of the Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 碰巧的是，就在第二天，她工作的那个全球卫生安全部门被特朗普政府的一名高级成员关闭了。

sentences.en: So fast forward two years, and it's early January, January 3rd.
sentences.zh: 快进两年，时间来到1月上旬，1月3日。

sentences.en: It's a Friday, and the
sentences.zh: 那是星期五，

sentences.en: Secretary of Health and Human Services, Alex Azar, is at home in Washington, and he gets this phone call from Robert Redfield, this doctor who's the head of the CDC.
sentences.zh: 卫生与公众服务部部长亚历克斯·阿扎在华盛顿的家中，接到了罗伯特·雷德菲尔德的电话，这位医生是疾控中心的负责人。

sentences.en: And Dr. Redfield tells Azar about these reports coming out of China, that there are these clusters of pneumonia cases, and that the likely culprit is a new coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 雷德菲尔德博士向阿扎通报了来自中国的这些报告，称出现了一些肺炎病例群，罪魁祸首很可能是一种新型冠状病毒。

sentences.en: And Alex Azar, the Health and Human Services Secretary, says this is a very big deal.
sentences.zh: 卫生与公众服务部部长亚历克斯·阿扎表示，这是一件非常严重的大事。

sentences.en: And what does Azar do with this information and this understanding that whatever this is, it's going to be a big deal?
sentences.zh: 阿扎如何处理这些信息以及对无论这是什么都将是一件大事的理解？

sentences.en: The Trump administration officials start meeting every day in the basement of the West Wing.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府官员开始每天在西翼地下室开会。

sentences.en: And so at first they say, OK, let's let's screen the flights that are coming from
sentences.zh: 所以起初他们说，好吧，让我们筛查来自

sentences.en: China.
sentences.zh: 中国的航班。

sentences.en: But there's an even more serious question that comes up, which is, should we ban flights altogether?
sentences.zh: 但随之而来的是一个更严肃的问题：我们是否应该彻底禁飞？

sentences.en: And should we deny entry to anybody who has come from China in the last 14 days to anybody who isn't a citizen or a permanent resident here?
sentences.zh: 我们是否应该拒绝任何在过去14天内去过中国的人入境，拒绝任何非美国公民或永久居民的人入境？

sentences.en: So then that debate got shifted right to the Oval
sentences.zh: 因此，这场辩论直接转移到了椭圆形

sentences.en: Office.
sentences.zh: 办公室。

sentences.en: And the top health officials of the nation at that point were agreed a ban from traveling from
sentences.zh: 当时全国顶尖的卫生官员一致认为，对疫情

sentences.en: the center of this epidemic could buy us some time, could help us to prepare ourselves before this came.
sentences.zh: 中心实施旅行禁令可以为我们争取一些时间，在疫情到来之前帮助我们做好准备。

sentences.en: It could slow that down.
sentences.zh: 这可以放慢传播速度。

sentences.en: The president asked, what could the consequences be on the economy?
sentences.zh: 总统询问，这对经济会产生什么后果？

sentences.en: All logical things that you would probably ask.
sentences.zh: 这都是你可能会问的符合逻辑的问题。

sentences.en: In the end, he sided with the aides who supported the idea that this could actually help protect our nation's health.
sentences.zh: 最终，他站在了支持这一举措可以帮助保护国家健康的助手一边。

sentences.en: The problem was we weren't completely prepared.
sentences.zh: 问题在于我们没有完全准备好。

sentences.en: Our government wasn't completely prepared to use that time.
sentences.zh: 我们的政府没有完全准备好利用这段时间。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你是什么意思？

sentences.en: The biggest issue that the government had to face was testing, being able to diagnose somebody who has this illness.
sentences.zh: 政府面临的最大问题是检测，即能够诊断出感染这种疾病的人。

sentences.en: And what is the problem with testing at this point?
sentences.zh: 此时检测的问题出在哪里？

sentences.en: Well, it didn't seem like there would be a problem.
sentences.zh: 嗯，似乎本不应该有问题。

sentences.en: Even though it was a new virus, the Chinese quickly made the sequence of it available, and labs were really quickly able to create a test for
sentences.zh: 尽管这是一种新病毒，但中国人迅速公布了它的基因序列，实验室很快就为其开发出了检测方法，

sentences.en: that, including the World Health Organization had already approved a test that was developed by some
sentences.zh: 包括世界卫生组织已经批准了由一些

sentences.en: German scientists.
sentences.zh: 德国科学家开发的检测方法。

sentences.en: But the U.S., which considers the CDC the world's premier public health agency, they decided to make their own teSt. But it didn't actually get FDA approved until the first
sentences.zh: 但美国将疾控中心视为世界首屈一指的公共卫生机构，他们决定自己制作检测。但直到2月的第一

sentences.en: week of February.
sentences.zh: 周才获得FDA批准。

sentences.en: And at that point, it could be distributed to public health laboratories across the country.
sentences.zh: 到那时，它才能分发给全国各地的公共卫生实验室。

sentences.en: But, you know, now we're already over a month into this scary new outbreak by that point.
sentences.zh: 但你知道，到那时这场可怕的新疫情已经持续了一个多月了。

sentences.en: So this is already off to a pretty slow start at a moment where every single day counts.
sentences.zh: 所以在每一天都至关重要的时刻，这已经是一个相当缓慢的开端。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So now we're like a month into this thing, and they're finally able to mail out the kits to public health laboratories around the country, state health laboratories, some big city
sentences.zh: 所以现在我们已经进入这个阶段大约一个月了，他们终于能够把试剂盒邮寄给全国各地的公共卫生实验室、州立卫生实验室、一些大城市的

sentences.en: health laboratories, this network of labs that our public health system has.
sentences.zh: 卫生实验室，也就是我们公共卫生系统拥有的这个实验室网络。

sentences.en: And the next day, you know, the first step that the labs have to do is they have to check that teSt. They have to, what's called, validate it, make sure it's working.
sentences.zh: 第二天，你知道，实验室要做的第一步是检查检测。也就是所谓的验证，确保它能正常工作。

sentences.en: And right that next day, the CDC starts getting reports from some of these public health labs saying, we're not able to validate this teSt.
sentences.zh: 就在第二天，疾控中心开始接到其中一些公共卫生实验室的报告，称：我们无法验证这个检测。

sentences.en: We're having probleMs. We're getting some inconclusive results.
sentences.zh: 我们遇到了问题。我们得到了一些不确定的结果。

sentences.en: And that's the first sign that something may have gone wrong.
sentences.zh: 这是可能出问题的第一个信号。

sentences.en: This test is not working.
sentences.zh: 这个检测根本没用。

sentences.en: Well, the CDC says it's definitely working in their lab.
sentences.zh: 嗯，疾控中心说它在他们的实验室里绝对好用。

sentences.en: So they told all the labs across the country, if it's not working for you, of course, don't use it.
sentences.zh: 所以他们告诉全国各地的所有实验室，如果对你们不管用，当然就不要用。

sentences.en: Just send samples to us.
sentences.zh: 直接把样本寄给我们。

sentences.en: Of course, that adds time.
sentences.zh: 当然，这增加了时间。

sentences.en: You have to collect a sample in your local area and then send it to Atlanta and then wait for that result to come back.
sentences.zh: 你必须在当地收集样本，然后寄到亚特兰大，接着等待结果返回。

sentences.en: So what impact does this testing snafu have at this point on our understanding of the epidemic?
sentences.zh: 那么，此时这场检测混乱对我们理解这场疫情有什么影响？

sentences.en: It just means that we don't know.
sentences.zh: 这只意味着我们一无所知。

sentences.en: We actually don't know.
sentences.zh: 我们真的不知道。

sentences.en: We say we have a low number of cases in this country at that point.
sentences.zh: 我们当时说这个国家的病例数很少。

sentences.en: But if you don't test, how can you know?
sentences.zh: 但如果你不进行检测，怎么会知道？

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And for these weeks where it seemed like we had cases in the low double digits in the United
sentences.zh: 在那些美国病例似乎处于低两位数的几周里，

sentences.en: States, and there was a sense that things were quite stable and the danger was pretty low, the virus very well could have been spreading and spreading widely.
sentences.zh: 人们觉得一切都相当稳定，危险性很低，但病毒很可能已经在广泛传播。

sentences.en: And we wouldn't have known because we weren't doing the testing that would have told us that.
sentences.zh: 而我们却一无所知，因为我们没有进行能告诉我们真相的检测。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And here's why.
sentences.zh: 原因如下。

sentences.en: Because only a small proportion of people who get the virus get really, really sick, fortunately.
sentences.zh: 因为幸运的是，感染病毒的人中只有一小部分人会病得非常非常重。

sentences.en: But by the time that they get into a critical care bed at a hospital and the doctors there are scratching their heads and they've tested for all the known things that
sentences.zh: 但当他们进入医院的重症监护室，那里的医生抓耳挠腮，对所有已知会导致肺炎和严重呼吸窘迫的病因都进行了检测时，

sentences.en: cause pneumonia and severe, severe respiratory distress, weeks have gone by since that person was infected.
sentences.zh: 距离那个人感染已经过去好几周了。

sentences.en: So you're actually looking at history.
sentences.zh: 所以你实际上是在回看历史。

sentences.en: If you finally get a positive test at that point, then yes, it has been spreading in the community.
sentences.zh: 如果你终于在那个时候得到了阳性检测结果，那么是的，它已经在社区中传播开了。

sentences.en: And that's all that time that you lose.
sentences.zh: 而那是你失去的所有时间。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So this time that the Trump administration had bought the American people with that dramatic step, with shutting its border to Chinese travelers, is kind of being squandered.
sentences.zh: 所以特朗普政府通过那项戏剧性的举措——关闭对中国旅客的边境——为美国人民争取到的时间，某种程度上正在被挥霍。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: There were so many people who were starting to feel at this point like this time was being squandered.
sentences.zh: 当时有很多人开始觉得时间正在被挥霍。

sentences.en: And we needed to get eyes on this.
sentences.zh: 我们需要密切关注这一点。

sentences.en: There were travelers coming from parts of the world where we didn't have a travel ban that now had a large number of cases.
sentences.zh: 有些旅客来自我们没有实施旅行禁令但现在有大量病例的世界其他地区。

sentences.en: And they weren't being screened at airports.
sentences.zh: 他们没有在机场接受筛查。

sentences.en: They were going out into the communities.
sentences.zh: 他们直接进入了社区。

sentences.en: And there was just this urgency of being able to test more.
sentences.zh: 当时迫切需要进行更多的检测。

sentences.en: And that's when this one group of doctors and researchers took matters into their own hands.
sentences.zh: 正是在那时，有一群医生和研究人员决定亲自动手。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Sherry, who is this doctor?
sentences.zh: 雪莉，这位医生是谁？

sentences.en: So her name is Helen Chu.
sentences.zh: 她的名字叫海伦·朱。

sentences.en: Hello, this is Helen.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是海伦。

sentences.en: Hi, Helen.
sentences.zh: 嗨，海伦。

sentences.en: How are you doing?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: I'm doing well.
sentences.zh: 我很好。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你呢？

sentences.en: I'm well, thanks.
sentences.zh: 我也很好，谢谢。

sentences.en: She's a physician and a researcher in Washington state, which is where the first case of coronavirus was detected in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 她是华盛顿州的一名内科医生和研究人员，美国的第一例冠状病毒就是1月在那里的。

sentences.en: back in January.
sentences.zh: 被检测出来的。

sentences.en: And she and her colleagues see a potential solution to this testing problem in their own work.
sentences.zh: 她和她的同事们在自己的工作中看到了解决这个检测问题的潜在方案。

sentences.en: We had a study in place that was set up for detection of respiratory viral illnesses in the community.
sentences.zh: 我们当时有一项针对社区呼吸道病毒感染检测设立的研究。

sentences.en: She specializes in studying how viruses pass from person to person within that same community.
sentences.zh: 她专门研究病毒如何在同一个社区内人际传播。

sentences.en: And she and her colleagues have this big study where they're collecting all these samples.
sentences.zh: 她和她的同事们有一项大型研究，正在收集所有这些样本。

sentences.en: From people who are sick and then testing them in the lab for flu and other respiratory viruses.
sentences.zh: 从生病的人身上收集样本，然后在实验室检测流感和其他呼吸道病毒。

sentences.en: And through collecting hundreds and hundreds of samples every week, they're trying to track the spread of viruses.
sentences.zh: 通过每周收集几百个样本，他们试图追踪病毒的传播。

sentences.en: And she was in the middle of collecting samples when the coronavirus arrives in Washington.
sentences.zh: 当冠状病毒抵达华盛顿州时，她正处于收集样本的阶段。

sentences.en: That is right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So we had this infrastructure in place already, essentially, in the Seattle area to be able to detect early entry of a virus into the city and then to understand how it spread.
sentences.zh: 所以我们在西雅图地区实际上已经有了这样一套基础设施，能够检测病毒对这座城市的早期入侵，然后了解它是如何传播的。

sentences.en: And that sounds like it would make her very well positioned to do the same thing for the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 听起来这使她处于能够对冠状病毒做同样事情的绝佳位置。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: She thought of that.
sentences.zh: 她想到了这一点。

sentences.en: The state health officials knew about their project and they immediately thought about the potential of this project to help with this issue of testing.
sentences.zh: 州卫生官员知道他们的项目，并立即想到了这个项目在协助解决检测问题方面的潜力。

sentences.en: And so what happens?
sentences.zh: 那么结果如何？

sentences.en: They make their own coronavirus test really fast and they're ready to go to help the state by the first week of February.
sentences.zh: 他们以极快的速度制作了自己的冠状病毒检测，准备在2月第一周协助州政府。

sentences.en: But there's one hitch.
sentences.zh: 但有一个小问题。

sentences.en: We had to go through regulatory clearance, essentially.
sentences.zh: 我们基本上必须通过监管审批。

sentences.en: We had to talk to CDC.
sentences.zh: 我们必须与疾控中心沟通。

sentences.en: We had to talk to FDA.
sentences.zh: 我们必须和FDA沟通。

sentences.en: They don't have the approval to test and then give those results out for two reasons.
sentences.zh: 他们没有获得批准进行检测然后公布这些结果，原因有二。

sentences.en: One is they're not a clinical lab, so they don't have the regulatory approval for that.
sentences.zh: 第一，他们不是临床实验室，所以他们没有这方面的监管批准。

sentences.en: And number two is they've just created this new coronavirus test, which isn't yet FDA approved.
sentences.zh: 第二，他们刚刚开发了这种新的冠状病毒检测方法，该方法尚未获得FDA批准。

sentences.en: So we were at a point where we could test thousands and thousands of samples at very high throughput.
sentences.zh: 所以我们当时能够以非常高的通量检测成千上万的样本。

sentences.en: But we didn't know what to do when we found the positive.
sentences.zh: 但我们不知道发现阳性结果时该怎么办。

sentences.en: So there's good reason to have some of those regulations in place.
sentences.zh: 因此，保留其中一些规章制度是有充分理由的。

sentences.en: But they figure this is a public health emergency and they feel like there's got to be some way
sentences.zh: 但他们认为这是一场公共卫生紧急事件，他们觉得必须找到某种方法

sentences.en: around this bureaucratic red tape where they could at least screen these samples and get that information out to the public health authorities to confirm that test, whatever it is.
sentences.zh: 绕过这些官僚作风，至少可以筛查这些样本，并将信息提供给公共卫生当局以确认该检测，无论结果如何。

sentences.en: But everybody felt very hesitant about us being able to provide results or to do the testing at all.
sentences.zh: 但对于我们是否能够提供结果或进行检测，所有人都感到非常犹豫。

sentences.en: The CDC doesn't seem to find a way around it.
sentences.zh: 疾病控制与预防中心（CDC）似乎找不到绕过它的方法。

sentences.en: Weeks go by and they're getting more and more frustrated and they're seeing the outbreak is growing in China and it's spreading to other countries.
sentences.zh: 几个星期过去了，他们越来越沮丧，看到疫情在中国不断蔓延，并正在向其他国家扩散。

sentences.en: So we know, you know, there's a potential for it to be an outbreak, not just in China.
sentences.zh: 所以我们知道，你知道的，这不仅在中国，在其他地方也有爆发的潜力。

sentences.en: We had the information, we had the data there sitting in our lab where we could actually answer the question.
sentences.zh: 我们有信息，我们的实验室里有数据，我们实际上可以回答这个问题。

sentences.en: And that was frustrating that we could answer it.
sentences.zh: 令人沮丧的是我们本可以解答。

sentences.en: We had the capacity to answer it, but we couldn't move forward because we didn't know what to do.
sentences.zh: 我们有能力解答，但我们无法推进，因为我们不知道该怎么做。

sentences.en: They feel like they're sitting on a gold mine and they feel like the virus very well could be out there.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得自己坐拥金矿，觉得病毒很有可能已经在外面传播了。

sentences.en: After all, there had been this case in Washington state more than a month earlier and nobody's had eyes on it.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，一个多月前华盛顿州就已经出现了这样一个病例，却没有人关注它。

sentences.en: Nobody's been doing surveillance in the community, testing samples.
sentences.zh: 没有人真正在社区进行监测和检测样本。

sentences.en: So they're getting more and more nervous.
sentences.zh: 所以他们变得越来越紧张。

sentences.en: Is there something we're not seeing because we're not really testing very widely?
sentences.zh: 是不是有什么我们没看到，因为我们并没有进行真正广泛的检测？

sentences.en: So what do they end up doing?
sentences.zh: 那他们最后做了什么？

sentences.en: Just kind of keeping those samples on ice and doing nothing?
sentences.zh: 只是把这些样本冷藏起来什么都不做吗？

sentences.en: Well, at first that's what they did because they thought they could speak with these officials and find out some official workaround so that they wouldn't be violating regulations
sentences.zh: 起初他们确实是这么做的，因为他们以为可以与这些官员沟通，找到某种官方的变通方法，这样他们就不会违反规定

sentences.en: and get in trouble.
sentences.zh: 并惹上麻烦。

sentences.en: Everyone wanted to be able to do this the proper way, to go through CDC and state labs and
sentences.zh: 每个人都希望以正确的方式做到这一点，通过CDC和州实验室，并且

sentences.en: have them have the high capacity to do the testing of all of these patients who really needed a diagnosis.
sentences.zh: 让他们有足够的高通量来对所有真正需要诊断的患者进行检测。

sentences.en: But it just couldn't be done.
sentences.zh: 但这根本行不通。

sentences.en: And then it gets to February 25th.
sentences.zh: 接着就到了2月25日。

sentences.en: I mean, the month is almost gone.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这个月快过完了。

sentences.en: It's more than a month since that first case.
sentences.zh: 距离首例确诊已经过去一个多月了。

sentences.en: And they finally just said,
sentences.zh: 他们最后终于说，

sentences.en: What we would do is move forward with research testing only.
sentences.zh: 我们要做的就是只推进研究性检测。

sentences.en: We're going to start using this unapproved coronavirus test that we have and that we believe is very reliable and start testing these samples.
sentences.zh: 我们将开始使用我们拥有的这种未获批的冠状病毒检测方法，我们认为它非常可靠，并开始检测这些样本。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So they're just going for it.
sentences.zh: 所以他们要直接干了。

sentences.en: Well, they're just going for it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们就是要直接干了。

sentences.en: And like, technically, they can test, right?
sentences.zh: 而且从技术上讲，他们可以检测，对吧？

sentences.en: But the issue is they can't report the results.
sentences.zh: 但问题是他们不能报告结果。

sentences.en: So what we would do would just be to go ahead and test the samples for coronavirus, but not to associate that with the information from the sample, so the clinical information.
sentences.zh: 所以我们要做的就是继续检测样本中的冠状病毒，但不要将这些结果与样本的信息，即临床信息关联起来。

sentences.en: So they have a plan to test for the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 所以他们有一个检测冠状病毒的计划。

sentences.en: And if they find it, that would mean that they're sitting on information that they're not supposed to have.
sentences.zh: 如果他们发现了病毒，那就意味着他们掌握了不该掌握的信息。

sentences.en: They're sitting on information that they're not supposed to communicate because of these regulatory issues.
sentences.zh: 由于这些监管问题，他们掌握了不该传达的信息。

sentences.en: It's all going to be fine as long as they don't find a case.
sentences.zh: 只要他们没有发现病例，一切都会好起来的。

sentences.en: OK, so once they decide to do that, what happened?
sentences.zh: 好的，一旦他们决定这么做，发生了什么？

sentences.en: What happened was one of the very first days that they started testing?
sentences.zh: 发生的事居然是在他们开始检测的最初几天里？

sentences.en: It was February 27th that we got the first positive.
sentences.zh: 我们在2月27日得到了第一个阳性结果。

sentences.en: They found a case.
sentences.zh: 他们发现了一个病例。

sentences.en: What I thought was, oh, no, if it came up that early in our testing, that meant that it had probably been here for a while and that we just didn't know that it was there.
sentences.zh: 我的想法是，噢不，如果我们的检测这么早就出现了阳性，这意味着它可能已经在本地存在一段时间了，而我们却一直不知道。

sentences.en: And so the questions racing through my head at that point were, what is the right thing to do right now?
sentences.zh: 因此，当时在我脑海中飞速闪过的问题是，现在到底该怎么做才是对的？

sentences.en: And so what happened at that point was that we rapidly convened the meeting of the investigators.
sentences.zh: 所以在那个时候发生的事情是，我们迅速召集了研究人员开会。

sentences.en: The group just convenes.
sentences.zh: 大家立刻聚在一起。

sentences.en: They all get on the phone and they talk about ethics at this point.
sentences.zh: 他们全员通电话，并在此时讨论了伦理问题。

sentences.en: We talked through the ethics of the different options.
sentences.zh: 我们探讨了各种可行方案背后的伦理考量。

sentences.en: Keep it to ourselves.
sentences.zh: 秘而不宣。

sentences.en: Tell public health.
sentences.zh: 上报公共卫生部门。

sentences.en: Or tell the participants.
sentences.zh: 或者告诉受试者。

sentences.en: They decide that the most ethical thing is to report the result to the local health authority.
sentences.zh: 他们决定最符合伦理的做法是将结果通报给地方卫生当局。

sentences.en: They confirmed the result.
sentences.zh: 他们确认了这一结果。

sentences.en: And it's this local teenager in the very same county as that first positive case, but no known link to that person and no travel history.
sentences.zh: 这是一个当地的青少年，住在和那个首例阳性病例相同的县，但与那个人没有已知的接触史，也没有旅行史。

sentences.en: And that next morning, the public health lab went out and they found this teenager who was feeling better by that point because he'd had a mild form of this illness, which is most
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，公共卫生实验室出动，找到了这名青少年。当时他已经感觉好多了，因为他患的是这种疾病的轻症，这在年轻人中

sentences.en: common, especially in young people, and they get to him just after he walks into his school
sentences.zh: 最为常见。他们在他刚刚走进学校时

sentences.en: because he's, yeah, and they end up shutting the school down to make sure that nobody else will catch the virus.
sentences.zh: 找到了他，因为他，对的，他们最终决定关闭学校，以确保其他人不会感染病毒。

sentences.en: I mean, that was a good moment for our team, I thought.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为这对我们的团队来说是一个高光时刻。

sentences.en: We thought, you know, we did something that didn't follow the rules, but we were able to prevent spread in a high school.
sentences.zh: 我们觉得，你知道的，我们做了一件不合规的事情，但我们成功阻止了病毒在一所高中的传播。

sentences.en: And that seemed really important.
sentences.zh: 这似乎非常重要。

sentences.en: So because of the doctor's actions, they catch him basically in the nick of time.
sentences.zh: 所以由于这位医生的行动，他们基本上在千钧一发之际抓住了它。

sentences.en: They do.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And they also realize that they may have a big problem on their hands because if this case descended from that first case, if that person potentially had infected somebody
sentences.zh: 他们也意识到他们可能面临一个大问题，因为如果这个病例是由首例病例传下来的，如果那个人可能在不知情的情况下

sentences.en: without knowing it, and then, you know, there was mild illness going on and nobody caught it, there could be hundreds of cases in the area.
sentences.zh: 传染了别人，然后呢，有轻症在传播却没有人发现，那么该地区可能会有数百个病例。

sentences.en: And so that gave them the information that they needed to start acting, to start looking more seriously for the virus in the community.
sentences.zh: 这为他们提供了开始行动所需的信息，以便在社区中更严肃地寻找病毒。

sentences.en: I wonder, had Dr. Chu not broken the rules in this case, how that would have changed how we understand the coronavirus in the Seattle region?
sentences.zh: 我在想，如果朱医生这次没有打破常规，会对我们理解西雅图地区的冠状病毒产生怎样的改变？

sentences.en: Well, we wouldn't have known until the people started dying that there was a problem.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在人们开始死亡之前，我们根本不会知道有问题。

sentences.en: And unfortunately, the really sad thing is that that happened really soon after that.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，最令人痛心的是，这种情况很快就发生了。

sentences.en: And so if Dr. Chu and her colleagues had been able to test sooner, they would have been able to alert the authorities earlier.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果朱医生和她的同事能够早点进行检测，他们就能更早地向当局发出警报。

sentences.en: And that's the real tragedy here.
sentences.zh: 这才是真正的悲剧所在。

sentences.en: You know, Sherry, on the one hand, the story that you have just told, it's a pretty heroic
sentences.zh: 你知道，雪莉，一方面，你刚刚讲述的故事，相当具有英雄主义色彩

sentences.en: story of a doctor willing to go against the rules, the instructions, because she felt that it was needed in the moment, in the midst of a public health crisis.
sentences.zh: ——一位医生愿意违背规则和指令，因为她觉得在公共卫生危机当前，这是迫切需要的。

sentences.en: On the other hand, it feels risky for the lesson here to be that medical professionals should go rogue in the middle of a crisis.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，如果给人们留下的教训是医疗专业人员在危机中应该独断专行、不守规矩，这似乎充满了风险。

sentences.en: I mean, what in your mind is the lesson here?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在你看来，这里的教训是什么？

sentences.en: I mean, I'm somebody who's reported on disasters for many years and used to do some disaster response myself.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我本人多年来一直在报道灾难，过去也曾参与过一些灾难救援工作。

sentences.en: And I've always seen in crises that thinking outside the box can really solve problems and it can save lives.
sentences.zh: 我发现在危机中，打破常规确实能解决问题并拯救生命。

sentences.en: And I think we generally accept that already, that the rules do have to bend, that people need to think creatively.
sentences.zh: 我想我们普遍已经接受了这一点，即规则确实需要变通，人们需要进行创造性思考。

sentences.en: And one of the reasons they have to do it, and it was so evident here, was that the larger system, the official responders,
sentences.zh: 他们必须这样做的原因之一，在这件事上表现得如此明显，那就是更大的系统、官方救援人员，

sentences.en: the official system in place, couldn't do everything and was faltering.
sentences.zh: 即现行的官方体系，无法面面俱到，并且正在步履蹒跚。

sentences.en: But I wonder how much would things potentially have been different, Sherry, if, thinking back
sentences.zh: 但我想知道，雪莉，回想我们谈话的开始，如果那些政府项目——例如国家安全委员会的卫生项目——没有被削减，情况可能会有多大不同？

sentences.en: to the start of our conversation, those government programs, the National Security Council's health program, for example, hadn't been cut?
sentences.zh: 我的意思，这在多大程度上反映了当前掌权者、特朗普政府对这场疫情的整体态度？

sentences.en: I mean, how much does that reflect an overall approach to this epidemic from the people currently in charge, from the Trump administration?
sentences.zh: 我认为你可以追溯到更早的时候。

sentences.en: I think you can trace it back further than that.
sentences.zh: 这是一个规律：每当危机发生时，这些项目总能得到充足的资金支持。

sentences.en: It is a pattern that these programs, when there's a crisis, they get really well funded.
sentences.zh: 但一旦埃博拉疫情成为历史，我们又开始削减政府的这些部门。

sentences.en: And as soon as Ebola recedes into history, we start cutting those parts of government.
sentences.zh: 你可以回顾一下炭疽袭击事件和

sentences.en: You can look back after the anthrax attacks and
sentences.zh: 911之后，当时有巨额资金投入到生物恐怖主义防范和医院防范中。

sentences.en: 9-11, and there was all this money that went into bioterrorism preparedness and hospital preparedness.
sentences.zh: 但你看这些数字，它们随着时间推移而下降。

sentences.en: And then you look at the numbers and they go down over time.
sentences.zh: 人类、社会和政府的反应通常是这样的：当它在新闻里、还在我们脑海中时，我们对它进行投资，然后我们又转过头去。

sentences.en: This is a reaction of humanity and society and government is to sort of like, when it's in the news and it's fresh in our minds, we invest in it, and then we turn away.
sentences.zh: 所以我感觉这是一个规律。

sentences.en: So I feel like this is a pattern.
sentences.zh: 当这种情况发生时，我们在防范上出现了政府似乎总是存在的漏洞，作为一名记者，我一次又一次发现的是，普通人会挺身而出，填补其中一些空白。

sentences.en: And when this happens, and we have these gaps in our preparedness that the government always
sentences.zh: 我此刻想到了卡特里娜飓风的画面：政府官员无法同时救出所有需要帮助的人。

sentences.en: seems to have, what I have found over and over again as a reporter is regular people step in and fill some of those holes.
sentences.zh: 人们在屋顶上挥舞毛巾，有人被困在医院里。

sentences.en: And I'm thinking right now, I have this image of Hurricane Katrina and government officials not being able to rescue everybody who needed help all at once.
sentences.zh: 然后就像那些拥有平底船的普通人——来自西路易斯安那州的渔民，他们出现了，直接把人们带到了干爽的土地上。

sentences.en: People waving towels off of rooftops and people stuck in hospitals.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我一次又一次地看到这样的例子。

sentences.en: And then it was like these regular people who had airboats who were fishermen from western Louisiana, and they show up and they just take people to dry ground.
sentences.zh: 在这个事件中，我们看到了朱医生和她的同事们正在做类似的事情。

sentences.en: You know, I've seen examples like that over and over.
sentences.zh: 但今天我和朱医生通电话时发现……

sentences.en: In this case, we saw Dr. Chu and her colleagues doing something like that.
sentences.zh: 昨天，华盛顿州的监管机构打电话给他们的实验室，要求我们关闭。

sentences.en: But what I found out today on the phone with Dr. Chu was that...
sentences.zh: 这个项目又被叫停了。

sentences.en: Yesterday, the Washington state regulators called their lab and asked us to shut down.
sentences.zh: 所以监管机构、州监管机构告诉他们不能再这样做了。

sentences.en: The project got shut down again.
sentences.zh: 看来政府不会允许这种填补空白的做法继续下去。

sentences.en: So the regulators, the state regulators told them they can't keep doing this.
sentences.zh: 因此，这个漏洞依然存在。

sentences.en: So it looks like the government isn't going to allow this to continue to fill that hole.
sentences.zh: 问题在于，这是否会成为从这场特定疫情中汲取的教训之一。

sentences.en: And so that hole remains.
sentences.zh: 当然，明天终究会到来。

sentences.en: The question is whether this will be one of those lessons that comes out of this particular outbreak.
sentences.zh: 总会有这样一天，我们不再处于当下这般令人恐惧的危机之中。

sentences.en: And of course, there will be a tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 问题是，这会不会落入那个老套的循环中：我们嘴上说吸取了教训、我们需要进行创新、

sentences.en: There will be a day where we're not in the midst of something so frightening that we're in right now.
sentences.zh: 建立能够确保我们处于更有利地位的新系统，以便我们拥有某种备用系统，从而让全国能够更迅速地推广检测？

sentences.en: And the question is, will this fit that same cycle where we say we've learned the lesson, we need to kind of innovate,
sentences.zh: 还是说，一旦直接的危险消退，我们就会停止投资或直接将它抛诸脑后？

sentences.en: come up with new systems that will ensure that we're in a better footing, that we can have some backup system so that we can roll out testing as a country much more quickly?
sentences.zh: 雪莉，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Or will this fit that same cycle where once the immediate danger goes away, we stop investing or we just forget?
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: Sherry, thank you.
sentences.zh: 几天前，我的同事彼得·贝克就新冠肺炎疫情询问特朗普总统，鉴于目前的疫情，他是否后悔取消了国家安全委员会的全球卫生部门。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得这件事，彼得，你永远不会真正认为它会发生。

sentences.en: A few days ago, my colleague Peter Baker asked President Trump whether he regrets eliminating the
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我早就听说过各种说法。

sentences.en: global health unit of the National Security Council in light of the coronavirus epidemic.
sentences.zh: 这可能，你知道的，这在发生之前可能就是一件大事。

sentences.en: I just think this is something, Peter, that you can never really think is going to happen.
